subject: ENGINEERING GRAPHICS AND COMPUTER AIDED DRAWING

details.name: ENGINEERING GRAPHICS AND COMPUTER AIDED DRAWING

topics: Introduction:  Relevance of technical drawing in engineering field.
BIS code of practice for technical drawing.
Projection of points in different quadrants
Projection of straight lines inclined to one plane and inclined to both planes.
Inclination  of lines with reference planes.
True length and true inclinations of line inclined to both the reference planes
Projection of Simple solids such as Triangular, Rectangle, Square, Pentagonal and Hexagonal Prisms, Pyramids, Cone and Cylinder only.
Projection of solids in simple position including profile view.
Projection of solids with axis inclined to one of the reference planes and with axis inclined to both reference planes.
Sections of Solids:  Sections of Prisms, Pyramids, Cone and Cylinder only, with axis in vertical position and cut by different section planes.
Development of Surfaces:  Development of surfaces of the solids and solids cut by different section planes.
Isometric Projection:  Isometric scale- Isometric View and Projections of Prisms, Pyramids, Cone, Cylinder, Sphere, Hemisphere and their combinations.
Computer Aided Drawing (CAD):  Introduction, Role of CAD in design and development of new products, Advantages of CAD.
Creating two-dimensional drawing with dimensions using suitable software.

partA.description: Student can choose any one full question out of two questions from each module

partB.description: Total 8 Questions, each question carries 15 marks

courseOutcomes.description: Understand the projection of points and lines located in different quadrants
Prepare Multiview orthographic projections of objects by visualizing them in different positions
Plot sectional views and develop surfaces of a given object
Prepare pictorial drawings using the principles of isometric projection
Sketch simple drawing using CAD tools.
